verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product assistant is a homepage marketing line saying users can describe what they want in plain text and Bento's AI will build it. Nothing documents what it builds, how far delegation goes, or how it works. The MCP server, CLI and Skills docs cover external agents connecting to Bento, not a built-in assistant, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the built-in AI's scope (flows, emails, segments), a description of the delegation and approval workflow, any hands-on or independent corroboration, and depth beyond a single marketing claim.
